reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis assumes W will form a single-phase fcc high-entropy alloy with FeCoNi, but W is a strong bcc stabilizer with very limited solubility in fcc Fe, Co, and Ni, making the proposed equiatomic FeCoNiW fcc alloy highly unlikely to form.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and would decisively falsify the hypothesis, but the falsification criterion is almost certain to be met because the starting premise (single-phase fcc FeCoNiW) is physically improbable.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is not useful because it proposes an alloy that is almost certain to be multiphase and bcc-based, failing the high-entropy alloy constraint and not addressing the core challenge of increasing coercivity in an fcc FeCoNi-based system.
